Peshawari is my new favourite in Jaipur. Of course, Dal Bukhara isn't famous for namesake it is a delight to taste buds and so is their Paneer Khurchan & Nan.The single person platter is no less in taste either.The only thing I will say has a huge room of improvement is about the process of booking a table at Peshawari, it's a pain. people don't pick calls and it takes 15mins to get one reservation. you need to improve this part.

Absolutely loved this restaurant. The staff were very helpful in making the reservations and when we arrived they even helped us change seats as the one we had chosen before was not too comfortable. We asked them for recommendations and absolutely loved what they served to us, the Dal Bukhaara and the meat platter combined with crispy naans made us simply jubilant. Located in the basement of the ITC Rajputana, due to the presence of an elevator, persons with reduced mobility can easily access this restaurant.

Never fails to disappoint, has maintained its standards always. Had a great time with great food and an extremely courteous staff.

My first visit to Peshawari ( Bukhara style restaurant ) turned out to be a memorable one. Just one word for the food - ‘Awesome’. Can’t get this quality and taste in any other five star for sure. Little expensive but worth it. We ordered murgh masala, paneer makhani which were perfectly cooked, great flavours. Daal bukhara is their speciality and it really stood upto the expectations. Naan and laccha paratha were tasty and crispy just the way I like it. Also a big thank you for the complementary cake for my mothers b’day. Staff is quick, well managing and courteous. Definitely a 5/5 and looking forward to many more visits.

The best dal bukhara in Jaipur. The food is just out of this world. The dal bukhara no words to describe it. The lamb seekh kebab were so soft and delicious. The pudina parantha and the naans were just amazing. For dessert the kulfi faluda was fantastic. 5/5 for everything.
Absolutely on dot as per there reputation they are the best when it come to food. Itc is way above all. Thanks

Peshawri is like a mini version of Bukhara. The must try here in Veg are paneer tikka and Dal Bukhara. The service is good, the staff is attentive. I have to say, I enjoyed every single bite of the meal at Peshawari. The pricing is definitely towards the higher end, hence expecting a wholesome experience is completely justified.

i got very satisfactory services i enjoyed a very pleasant time with my family and cousin it has a very big and neat and clean swimming pool facility . the hotel staff is very helpful and the place creates a very beautiful vibes here .. i was relaxed being there and had my morning breakfast with my family on time .. they are very punctual of there service hours..

Giant chunks of the mushy PANNER TIKKA,heavenly Dal Bukhara (Morgan Freeman says "I agree") flavours screaming the excellence of the North-West Frontier. I really loved the place. The food is amazing, beyond comparision to any other place I've dined at in Jaipur. Beautiful setting to equally beautiful food. Dal bukhara gets a special mention and the rotis just melt in your mouth, yes they are so good. The staff and ambiance amazing. Anyone who is in Jaipur must visit Masala Chowk for a hot of tea or a plate of Jalebi. The open space is walkable from the famous Albert Hall Museum and has an entry fee of Rs 10. There are many food stalls inside and a very nice seating for customers in the middle of the area. It is a self service kind of place and almost everything that we ordered here was delicious. I would personally recommend any item from Samrat followed by hot chai from Gulab Ji chai wale. The space is open, airy, and has plenty of greenery with ample parking space. The place can get crowded during the weekends though.

My first visit to Peshawari ( Bukhara style restaurant ) turned out to be a memorable one. Just one word for the food - ‘Awesome’. Can’t get this quality and taste in any other five star for sure. Little expensive but worth it. We ordered murgh masala, paneer makhani which were perfectly cooked, great flavours. Daal bukhara is their speciality and it really stood upto the expectations. Naan and laccha paratha were tasty and crispy just the way I like it. Also a big thank you for the complementary cake for my mothers b’day. Staff is quick, well managing and courteous. Definitely a 5/5 and looking forward to many more visits.

The best dal bukhara in Jaipur. The food is just out of this world. The dal bukhara no words to describe it. The lamb seekh kebab were so soft and delicious. The pudina parantha and the naans were just amazing. For dessert the kulfi faluda was fantastic. 5/5 for everything.

Anyone who is in Jaipur must visit Masala Chowk for a hot of tea or a plate of Jalebi. The open space is walkable from the famous Albert Hall Museum and has an entry fee of Rs 10. There are many food stalls inside and a very nice seating for customers in the middle of the area. It is a self service kind of place and almost everything that we ordered here was delicious. I would personally recommend any item from Samrat followed by hot chai from Gulab Ji chai wale. The space is open, airy, and has plenty of greenery with ample parking space. The place can get crowded during the weekends though.
